findings.evidence: F ≈ 96,485 C/mol e⁻ is correct. The conversion table is dimensionally and chemically correct. Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu(s) requires 2 mol e⁻ per mol Cu; 2 × 96,485 = 192,970 C, correctly rounded to 1.93 × 10⁵ C. The same charge–electron–substance stoichiometry applies to galvanic and electrolytic cells. The Weak answer violates step 1, and Full-credit parts (1) and (2) match the two stated steps.
